caption: The video captures an outdoor cooking scene in which a black cast-iron skillet rests over a fire, an orange glow visible beneath it, holding a bubbling, foamy mixture of pale chunks simmering in liquid. A hand at the upper right grips a wooden spoon and works it through the pan in repeated stirring arcs, sweeping across the surface while the grip and angle shift slightly. A tall plume of white steam billows upward against green conifers and a partly cloudy sky. Separate from the spoon, a thin vertical column of amber liquid descends from above the top of the frame toward the center of the pan, alternating between a continuous thread and a train of separated droplets, its visible length varying as it falls. The food surface churns and bubbles throughout, with the frothy rim and chunk arrangement shifting with each stir, while a wooden board holding flatbread and red chilies remains partly visible at the right edge.
relations: Skillet heat from the fire causes the simmering mixture to emit a rising plume of white steam.
The hand's repeated stirring with the wooden spoon shifts the bubbling food surface and frothy rim.
The falling amber liquid alternates between a continuous thread and separated droplets as it descends toward the pan.
The wooden board holding flatbread and chilies remains stationary at the right edge during the cooking process.
